name: ruflo
description: Ruflo (ruvnet/ruflo, MIT): an agent meta-harness. Its 95 agents and 38 skills are built into LOKI (Settings > Agents, the skill catalog, team playbooks). This add-on is its MCP server (swarms, memory, agent tools) for LOKI's agents: needs Node/npx, then LOKI_MCP_ENABLE=ruflo.
